statuses.label: unbound_statement
statuses.definition: A mathematical statement not yet bound to a lemma, proof, source document, or dependency graph.
statuses.publication_language: may be discussed only as an informal motivation or open note

statuses.label: registered_conjecture
statuses.definition: A statement registered with source context and dependencies but lacking proof.
statuses.publication_language: conjecture, proposed relation, open formal target

statuses.label: conditional_lemma
statuses.definition: A lemma with a valid dependency chain but conditional on declared assumptions or open gaps.

statuses.label: proved_within_formal_stack
statuses.definition: A lemma or theorem proved within the current PCD formal stack, with all dependencies registered.
promotion_requirements: All lemma dependencies resolved or at TS3+
statuses.publication_language: proved within the PCD formal stack

statuses.label: simulation_supported_theorem
statuses.definition: A formal result with matching governed simulation support and recoverable artifacts.
statuses.publication_language: formal result with governed simulation support

statuses.label: externally_validated_result
statuses.definition: A formal result with independent reproduction, recoverable artifacts, and external validation.
promotion_requirements: External peer review or independent replication
statuses.publication_language: externally validated within stated model class
